title: xPunish
description: A GUI-driven staff punishment plugin for Paper 1.20+ with rank-based permissions, auto-escalating mutes & bans, full audit logging, and Discord webhook support.
body:
**xPunish** is a GUI-driven moderation plugin built exclusively for Paper 1.20.4+. It gives your staff team a clean, rank-aware punishment interface with automatic escalation, a full audit trail, and a complete set of chat shortcut commands — no config bloat, no database required.

📖 Read the Full Documentation Here

**Key features:** - Inventory GUI — warn, kick, mute, and ban from a single /punish command; buttons hide automatically based on the staff member's rank - Chat shortcuts — /warn, /kick, /tempmute, /tempban, and /unmute for experienced staff who prefer speed over menus - Auto-escalation — separate mute and ban strike tracks with fully configurable duration tiers (3h → 6h → 1d → 3d → 1w → permanent) - Paginated history — /history shows a full colour-coded punishment record across multiple pages - Staff audit log — /stafflog shows every punishment a specific staff member has ever issued - Rank protection — staff cannot punish players of equal or higher rank - Custom reasons — every reason menu includes a "✎ Custom Reason..." option letting staff type a freeform reason directly in chat - Mute expiry notifications — players are notified the moment their mute expires while online - Discord webhook — every punishment fires an embed to your moderation channel automatically - Live reload — /xpunish reload applies all config, rank, and message changes with no restart Requirements: Paper 1.20.4+ · No dependencies · YAML storage · LuckPerms recommended for rank assignment
